Match the following columns:

\begin{array}{|l|l|}
\hline
\text{\textbf{Column-I}} & \text{\textbf{Column-II}} \\
\hline
\text{(A) } \displaystyle \lim_{n \to \infty} 4 \left[ \frac{1}{n^2} e^{\frac{1}{n}} + \frac{2}{n^2} e^{\frac{2}{n}} + \frac{3}{n^2} e^{\frac{3}{n}} + \dots + \frac{1}{n} e^{\frac{n}{n}} \right] =  & \text{(P) } \displaystyle 0  \\
\text{(B) } \displaystyle \int_0^1 \ln \left( \frac{1}{x} - 1 \right) dx =  & \text{(Q) } \displaystyle 1  \\
\text{(C) } \displaystyle \int_0^{10\pi} \left( \lim_{x \to y} \left( \frac{\sin x - \sin y}{x - y} \right) \right) dy =  & \text{(R) } \displaystyle 2  \\
\text{(D) } \displaystyle \int_0^\infty \frac{\ln(x + \frac{1}{x}) dx}{(1 + x^2)} = \frac{\pi}{2} \ln a \text{, then } \displaystyle a =  & \text{(S) } \displaystyle 4  \\
 & \text{(T) } \displaystyle 5  \\
\hline
\end{array}

questions.q:
Match the following $\int f(x) dx$ is equal to, if

\begin{array}{|l|l|}
\hline
\text{\textbf{Column-I}} & \text{\textbf{Column-II}} \\
\hline
\text{(A) } \displaystyle f(x) = \frac{1}{(x^2 + 1)\sqrt{x^2 + 2}}  & \text{(P) } \displaystyle \frac{x^5}{5(1 - x^4)^{5/2}} + C  \\
\text{(B) } \displaystyle f(x) = \frac{1}{(x + 2)\sqrt{x^2 + 6x + 7}}  & \text{(Q) } \displaystyle \sin^{-1} \left( \frac{x + 1}{(x + 2)\sqrt{2}} \right) + C  \\
\text{(C) } \displaystyle f(x) = \frac{x^4 + x^8}{(1 - x^4)^{7/2}}  & \text{(R) } \displaystyle (\sqrt{x} - 2)\sqrt{1 - x} + \cos^{-1}\sqrt{x} + C  \\
\text{(D) } \displaystyle f(x) = \sqrt{\frac{1 - \sqrt{x}}{1 + \sqrt{x}}}  & \text{(S) } \displaystyle -\tan^{-1} \sqrt{1 + \frac{2}{x^2}} + C  \\
 & \text{(T) } \displaystyle \frac{x^6}{6(1 - x^4)^{5/2}} + C  \\
\hline
\end{array}

\text{(A) } \displaystyle \int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\cos x}{(1 + \sin x)(2 + \sin x)} dx =  & \text{(P) } \displaystyle \frac{\pi}{6}  \\
\text{(B) } \displaystyle \int_0^{41\pi/4} |\cos x| dx =  & \text{(Q) } \displaystyle 20 + \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}  \\
\text{(C) } \displaystyle \int_{-1/2}^{1/2} \left[ [x] + \ln \left( \frac{1 + x}{1 - x} \right) \right] dx = \text{ (where } \displaystyle [\cdot] \text{ represents greatest integer function)} & \text{(R) } \displaystyle \ln 4 - \ln 3  \\
\text{(D) } \displaystyle \int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{2\sqrt{\cos \theta}}{3(\sqrt{\sin \theta} + \sqrt{\cos \theta})} d\theta =  & \text{(S) } \displaystyle -\frac{1}{2}  \\

Match the following columns:

\begin{array}{|l|l|}
\hline
\text{\textbf{Column-I}} & \text{\textbf{Column-II}} \\
\hline
\text{(A) } \displaystyle \int_0^{1.5} [x^2] dx  & \text{(P) } \displaystyle -\pi  \\
\text{(B) } \displaystyle \int_0^4 \{\sqrt{x}\} dx \text{ (where } \displaystyle \{x\} \text{ denotes the fractional part of } \displaystyle x \text{)} & \text{(Q) } \displaystyle 4(\sqrt{2} - 1)  \\
\text{(C) } \displaystyle \int_0^{2\pi} [\sin x + \cos x] dx  & \text{(R) } \displaystyle \frac{7}{3}  \\
\text{(D) } \displaystyle \int_0^\pi ||\sin x| - |\cos x|| dx  & \text{(S) } \displaystyle 2 - \sqrt{2}  \\
\hline
\end{array}
